nodes.label: System Administrator (Actor)
nodes.rationale: Platform-level actor kept entirely outside the farm business domain; its sole use case is device fleet administration, so infrastructure privilege never implies access to farm operational or financial data.

nodes.label: Manage Edge Devices (UC22)
nodes.source_location: UML use case diagram, single page
nodes.rationale: Registration and lifecycle control of IoT hardware; centralising it under one administrator actor keeps the device trust boundary auditable.

nodes.label: Issue Device Token
nodes.rationale: Machine identity is provisioned per device rather than sharing a global API key, so a compromised sensor node can be revoked individually without disrupting the rest of the fleet; this is the credential that the Edge Device later presents to Authenticate.
